data.Name: Abandoned Catapult
data.Description: An abandoned siege catapult sits in a field, fully loaded with artisanal cheese wheels. A note pinned to it reads: 'Free to good home. Warning: hair trigger. NOT responsible for cheese-related injuries. - Previous Owner (who learned the hard way)'
data.Outcomes: [{"probability": 0.40, "type": "player_choice", "text": "The catapult creaks ominously in the breeze. The cheese wheels are surprisingly aerodynamic. You can see dents in a distant hillside from previous firings.", "params": {"choices": [{"name": "Fire the Catapult", "risk": 0.4, "success": {"type": "none", "text": "LAUNCH! The cheese sails majestically through the air and lands... nowhere important. Direct hit on nothing! But what a shot! The style points alone were worth it."}, "failure": {"type": "damage_player", "damage": 6, "text": "The catapult misfires spectacularly! You hit yourself. WITH CHEESE. A wheel of aged gouda to the face. The shame hurts more than the cheese. Almost."}}, {"name": "Take the Cheese", "risk": 0.0, "effect": {"type": "draw_card", "text": "Cheese acquired! It's surprisingly well-preserved siege ammunition. 'Vintage Catapult Cheddar' would make an excellent band name.", "params": {"card_type": "Junk Card"}}}]}}, {"probability": 0.20, "type": "none", "text": "The catapult fires on its own!
